entries.zh: 以手扶稳、撑住；扠（用手支撑）
entries.en: to steady or prop up with the hand

entries.zh: 用手撑住往下按；扠落去
entries.en: to press or steady down with the hand

entries.zh: 撑住使物不倒不坠；扠倒（扶持稳当）
entries.en: to prop up so that something does not fall
haggard, afflicted; to grieve, be worn with sorrow
to be distressed, grieved at heart

entries.zh: 凌剔（凌迟之属），百般折磨、极度苦恼
entries.en: to be tormented, greatly afflicted
entries.notes: 汉字「凌剔」属俗写组合，依西语 afligirse mucho 及音写 lêng-tī 定为折磨义，展开略带推断。

entries.en: affliction, suffering
suffering and distress; to be afflicted
to be greatly afflicted
sad, wretched; to grieve over hardships
to grieve and weep over it
to weep and cry out in grief

entries.zh: 惨切，悲惨凄切；愁苦而哭而恚怒
entries.en: bitter and poignant; to grieve, weep, and fret
entries.notes: 「惨切」字面为悲惨凄切，西语附 agastarse（恼怒）义，结合略带推断。

entries.en: to flee hardship, take refuge; to shun trouble

entries.zh: 气杀（死）人，气得人呕血欲死
entries.en: to enrage someone to the point of vomiting blood (or dying)
entries.notes: 西语栏有「pasado (?)」字样为抄录存疑标记；source_R 三字作 quìi zā xīn，「杀」对应稍拗，依汉字与闽南音写定释义。

entries.en: to enrage someone to death; to vex someone sorely

entries.zh: 局局死（郁郁将死），愁闷得只差一死
entries.en: so afflicted that death alone remains
entries.notes: 「局々」叠字俗写依闽南音写 quiòt-quiòt 定为郁结愁闷义，汉字确认度一般。

entries.en: to loosen, release, let go

entries.zh: 放伊松（放伊拎），把系紧之物放开、松绑
entries.en: to loosen what is bound, untie it
entries.notes: 第三字「拎」与闽南音写 lěng 合，西语 afloxar lo atado 释为松开所缚之物；组合展开略带推断。

entries.zh: 放松，放宽、松懈；宽减刑罚、免其罪责
entries.en: to loosen or relax; to remit punishment, show leniency
